answer: To join, it submits a marble hash proving stake provenance and a plume signature tying the token to a live peer quorum. Each agent must stake a unique timber token harvested from its verified hardware root, binding identity to physical cost. Duplicate identities fail because cloning the timber requires re-mining hardware, and forging the marble hash costs more than the reward, making sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
